name: Ginger Chicken Meatball Stir-Fry with Noodles, Snap Peas & Cashews

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse under cold water; set aside.
Meanwhile, place soy sauce, fish sauce, water, honey, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup soy sauce
3 tbsp fish sauce
3 tbsp water
2 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp black pepper
3 pinch clove, ground
3 pinch cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 medium carrots
3 (227 g) pkg sugar snap peas
2 small bunches green onions (scallions)
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger; place in a medium bowl along with chicken, additional soy sauce, and pepper. Using your hands, mix well to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg ground chicken
1 tbsp soy sauce
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a tablespoon measure, form the chicken mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a plate.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; working in batches if necessary, add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with foil. (Reserve pot with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into thin rounds; halve snap peas crosswise. Place both in a large bowl.
Trim and slice green onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the other veggies.
Return pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and stir-fry until fork-tender, 4-5 minutes.
While the veggies are cooking, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, add noodles, sauce, and cilantro to the pot; cook, stirring frequently, until the noodles are coated and warmed through, 3-4 minutes.
To serve, divide noodles, veggies, and meatballs between bowls; top with cashews and enjoy!
